package.name: geos
package.summary: PHP extension for interfacing with the GEOS library
package.description: This extension provides a PECL package for the GEOS library. The 1.1.x series is an extended fork tracking GEOS 3.11+ (target 3.14.x) and exposes the broader GEOS C API: CoordSeq, MakeValid, Concave/Polygon hulls, precision-grid overlays, GeoJSON I/O, fix-structure WKT/WKB readers, hull and metric extras, distance extras, linear-referencing extras, curved geometry constructors, geometry construction factories, coverage processing, clustering, constrained Delaunay, STRtree spatial index, PreparedGeometry, coordinate-transform callbacks, and Hilbert/orientation helpers.
package.notes: - Extended fork at https://github.com/avdmerwe/php-geos targeting libgeos 3.14.x. - Minimum required GEOS bumped to 3.11.0 (drops 3.10 fallbacks). - New class GEOSCoordSeq (foundation for curved/factory work, full Z/M). - New classes GEOSGeoJSONReader / GEOSGeoJSONWriter (RFC7946 geometry I/O). - New class GEOSSTRtree (insert/remove/query/iterate/nearest, callback API). - New class GEOSPreparedGeometry (predicates, distance, nearestPoints). - New class GEOSClusterResult (DBSCAN / by-distance / by-intersection). - GEOSGeometry: makeValid (linework + structure), concaveHull family, polygonHullSimplify, precision-grid overlays (intersection / difference / symDifference / union with optional gridSize), hull-and-metric extras (minimumBoundingCircle, minimumRotatedRectangle, minimumWidth, minimumClearance, maximumInscribedCircle, largestEmptyCircle), distance extras (distanceWithin, distanceIndexed, nearestPoints, frechet/Hausdorff variants), linear-referencing extras (lineSubstring, lineMergeDirected), construction utilities (reverse, densify, removeRepeatedPoints, orientPolygons, equalsIdentical, getX/Y min/max, getExtent, buildArea), curved-geometry constructors (CircularString, CompoundCurve, CurvePolygon), coverage processing (coverageUnion, coverageIsValid, coverageSimplifyVW, coverageClean), clustering (clusterDBSCAN, clusterByDistance, clusterByIntersection), constrained Delaunay, geometry construction factories (createPoint*, createLineString, createLinearRing, createPolygon, createCollection, createRectangle), coordinate-transform callbacks (transformXY, transformXYZ), and P2 fillers (hilbertCode, gridIntersectionFractions, orientationIndex, segmentIntersection). - WKT/WKB readers gain setFixStructure(); WKB writer gains setFlavor()/getFlavor() with GEOSWKB_EXTENDED (default) and GEOSWKB_ISO. - Backwards compatible with 1.0.0 callers (no removed/renamed methods). - Tests: 25 .phpt files, all green against libgeos 3.14.1.

release.notes: - Extended fork tracking libgeos 3.14.x. - Minimum GEOS bumped to 3.11.0. - ~80 new methods + 6 new classes covering CoordSeq, MakeValid, ConcaveHull, GeoJSON, STRtree, PreparedGeometry, clustering, coverage, curved geometries, factories, transforms, and more. - Backwards compatible with 1.0.0 callers.
